title: Government College University Lahore Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Government College University Lahore Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2004
ACT II OF 2004
GOVERNMENT COLLEGE
UNIVERISTY, LAHORE
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2004
An act to amend
the Government College University, Lahore Ordinance, 2002.
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 25th February, 2004]
No. PAP-Legis-2(17)/2003/575,
dated 23-2-2004.---The Government College University, Lahore (Amendment)
Bill 2003, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 7th
January, 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 19th February,
2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Government College
University, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2). It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of

No. PAP-Legis-2(17)/2003/575,
dated 23-2-2004.---The Government College University, Lahore (Amendment)
Bill 2003, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 7th
January, 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 19th February,
2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
4. Addition of section 11-A in
Ordinance XLVIII of 2002.---In the said Ordinance, after section 11, the
following new section 11-A shall be added:-
"11-A. Pro-Chancellor.--(1)
The Minister for Education, Government of the Punjab, shall be the
Pro-Chancellor of the University:
(2) He shall perform such duties
and functions and exercise such powers as may be assigned and delegated to him
by the Chancellor."
